Then two silver stands were placed under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so they could be joined together. Twenty of these frames were used along the south side and 20 more along the north. 27Six frames were used for the back wall along the west side 28-29with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. These corner frames were joined from top to bottom. 30Altogether, along the back wall there were eight frames with two silver stands under each of them.
31-33Five crossbars were made for each of the wooden frames, with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall. 34The frames and crossbars were covered with gold, and gold rings were attached to the frames to run the crossbars through.
The Inside Curtain for the Sacred Tent
(Exodus 26.31-37)
35They made the inside curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. 36They also made four acacia wood posts and covered them with gold. Then gold rings were fastened to the posts, which were set on silver stands.
37For the entrance to the tent, they used a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework. 38They made five posts, covered them completely with gold, and set each of them on a gold-covered bronze stand. Finally, they attached hooks for the curtain.
translation_text:
Wɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ no brɛ adwumfoɔ no
1Na Besalel ne Oholiab ne wɔn a AWURADE ama wɔn nimdeɛ ne nhunumu sɛ wɔnhunu adeɛ no yɛ nyinaa na wɔbɛyɛ kronkronbea ɔsom no ho adwuma sɛdeɛ AWURADE ahyɛ no. 2Na Mose frɛɛ Besalel, Oholiab ne animdefoɔ a AWURADE de nyansa ahyɛ wɔn akoma mu nyinaa, wɔn a wɔn akoma kanyan wɔn sɛ wɔmmra adwuma no ho mmɛyɛ nyinaa. 3Na wɔgyee mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ a Israelfoɔ de baa sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ kronkronbea som ho adwuma no nyinaa Mose anim sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ. Na wɔkɔɔ so ara de ayamyi ayɛyɛdeɛ brɛɛ no daa anɔpa. 4Na adwumfoɔ a wɔyɛ kronkronbea no ho adwuma nyinaa firi wɔn nnwuma a wɔreyɛ no ho ba 5bɛka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Ɔman no ama deɛ wɔde ba no adɔɔso sene deɛ ɛbɛso adwuma a AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ no. 6Na Mose hyɛ maa wɔpaee no nsraban no mu sɛ: Ɔbarima oo, ɔbaa oo, obiara mmfa biribi mmmɛyɛ kronkronbea no ho mmasoɔ afɔrebɔdeɛ bio. 7Ɛnna ɔman no de gyaee ba. Ɛfiri sɛ na deɛ wɔanya no dɔɔso ma adwuma no nyinaa sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ ama ebi aka.
Apam adaka no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 26.1-37)
8 Na wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no animdefoɔ nyinaa yɛɛ tenabea no; wɔde asaawa fitaa a wɔafira ne bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan yɛɛ ntoma du, kerubim a ɛyɛ ntomanwono mu adwini na wɔde yɛeɛ. 9Ntoma biara tentene yɛ basafa dunan, na ntoma biara tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa mmienu; ntoma no nyinaa nsusuiɛ yɛ bafua. 10Na ɔde ntoma no nnum toatoaa so maa baako toaa baako so, na ɔde ntoma no nnum nso toatoaa so maa baako toaa baako so. 11Na ɔde bibire bobɔɔ ntoma baako mmuano so nkantankoraa wɔ ano wɔ ntoaeɛ no mmuano so wɔ ntoaeɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu no so; 12nkantankoraa aduonum na ɔbobɔɔ no ntoma baako ano, na nkantankoraa aduonum nso na ɔbobɔɔ no ntoma a ɛwɔ ntoaeɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu no soɔ no ano; nkantankoraa no dii mmɔanim. 13Na ɔyɛɛ sika nkɔtɔkorɔ aduonum, na ɔde nkɔtɔkorɔ no koakoaa ntoma no, na tenabea no yɛɛ fua.
14Na ɔyɛɛ mmirekyie nwi ntoma de yɛɛ ntomadan wɔ tenabea no so; ntoma dubaako na ɔyɛeɛ. 15Ntoma baako tentene yɛ basafa dunum, na ntoma baako tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa mmienu; ntoma dubaako no nsusuiɛm yɛ pɛ. 16Na ɔde ntoma no nnum toatoaa so yɛɛ no bafua, na ɔde nsia nso toatoaa so yɛɛ no bafua. 17Na ɔbobɔɔ nkantankoraa aduonum, ntoma a ɛdi akyire no mmuano so, wɔ ntoaeɛ no so, na ɔbobɔɔ nkantankoraa aduonum nso wɔ ntoaeɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ntoma no mmuano so. 18Na ɔyɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nkɔtɔkorɔ aduonum de koakoaa ntomadan no na ayɛ bafua.
19Na ɔde adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ yɛɛ ntomadan no nkatasoɔ, na ɔde sukraman nwoma yɛɛ ɛno so nkatasoɔ.
20 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ tenabea no ntaaboɔ a ɛsisi hɔ no. 21Taaboɔ baako tentene yɛ basafa nnum, na taaboɔ baako tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 22Ɛnan mmienu tuatua taaboɔ baako ase, na biribi sosɔ ɛnan baako ne baako mu. Saa na ɔyɛɛ tenabea ntaaboɔ no nyinaa ho. 23Na ɔyɛɛ tenabea ntaaboɔ no: Ntaaboɔ aduonu di anafoɔ fam a ɛkyerɛ nifa. 24Na ɔyɛɛ ntaaboɔ aduonu no ase dwetɛ nnyinasoɔ aduanan; nnyinasoɔ mmienu hyehyɛ taaboɔ koro ase ma ne nan mmienu no, na nnyinasoɔ mmienu hyehyɛ taaboɔ koro nso ase ma ne nan mmienu no. 25Na tenabea no nkyɛn baako a ɛdi atifi fam no, ɔde ntaaboɔ aduonu kɔsisii hɔ, 26ne ne dwetɛ nnyinasoɔ aduanan, taaboɔ koro ase nnyinasoɔ mmienu, na koro nso ase nnyinasoɔ mmienu. 27Na tenabea no akyiri fam a ɛkyerɛ atɔeɛ no, ɔde ntaaboɔ nsia kɔsisii hɔ. 28Na ɔde ntaaboɔ mmienu kɔsisii tenabea no akyiri ntwea no so, 29na ɛpam ho firi fam de rekorɔ, nanso ɛyɛ mu kɔduru ne hini so, deɛ kaa a ɛdi kan no tua hɔ: Saa na ɔyɛɛ ne mmienu nyinaa ntwea mmienu no soɔ. 30Na ntaaboɔ nwɔtwe ne ne dwetɛ nnyinasoɔ dunsia na ɛwɔ hɔ, taaboɔ biara ase nnyinasoɔ mmienu. 31 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ mmeamu, tenabea no nkyɛn baako ntaaboɔ no deɛ enum, 32ne tenabea no nkyɛn baako no nso ntaaboɔ no mmeamu enum no ne tenabea no akyi, atɔeɛ fam ntaaboɔ no deɛ, mmeamu nnum. 33Na ɔde mfimfini mmeamu no beaa ntaaboɔ no mfimfini de twaa mu firi tire kɔduruu tire. 34Na ɔde sika duraduraa ntaaboɔ no ho, na ɔde sika yɛɛ ɛho nkaa no sɛ ɛnyɛ mmeamu no hyehyɛbea, na ɔde sika duraduraa mmeamu no ho. 35 Na ɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira yɛɛ ntwamutam; ɔyɛɛ no ntomanwono mu adwini a kerubim wɔ mu. 36Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho okuo adum nnan, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho; ne mprɛngo yɛ sika. Na ɔde dwetɛ nnyinasoɔ nnan guu aseɛ.
37Na ɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira nwonoo nkyeremu de yɛɛ ntomadan no ano nkataano. 38Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho adum nnum ne mprɛngo, na ɔde sika duraduraa n’atifi ne ne mmeamu ho, na ne nnyinasoɔ nnum yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ.

english_text:
The Sacred Chest
(Exodus 25.10-22)
1Bezalel built a chest of acacia wood 110 centimeters long, 66 centimeters wide, and 66 centimeters high. 2He covered it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the top. 3He made four gold rings and attached one of them to each of the four legs of the chest. 4Then he made two poles of acacia wood, covered them with gold, 5and put them through the rings, so the chest could be carried by the poles.
6The entire lid of the chest, which was made of pure gold, was the place of mercy. 7-9On each of the two ends of the chest he made a winged creature of hammered gold. They faced each other, and their wings covered the place of mercy.
The Table for the Sacred Bread
(Exodus 25.23-30)
10Bezalel built a table of acacia wood 88 centimeters long, 44 centimeters wide, and 66 centimeters high. 11-12He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border 75 millimeters thick. 13He made four gold rings and attached one to each of the legs 14near the edging. The poles for carrying the table were placed through these rings 15and were made of acacia wood covered with gold. 16Everything that was to be set on the table was made of pure gold—the bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings.
The Lampstand
(Exodus 25.31-40)
17Bezalel made a lampstand of pure gold. The whole lampstand, including its decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered gold, 18with three branches on each of its two sides. 19There were three decorative almond blossoms on each branch 20and four on the stem. 21There was also a blossom where each pair of branches came out from the stem. 22The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, was made from a single piece of hammered pure gold. 23-24The lamp and its equipment, including the tongs and trays, were made of about 35 kilograms of pure gold.
The Altar for Burning Incense
(Exodus 30.1-5)
25For burning incense, Bezalel made an altar of acacia wood. It was 45 centimeters square and 90 centimeters high with each of its four corners sticking up like the horn of a bull. 26He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it. 27Then below the edging on opposite sides he attached two gold rings through which he put the poles for carrying the altar. 28These poles were also made of acacia wood and covered with gold.
The Oil for Dedication and the Incense
(Exodus 30.22-38)
29 Bezalel mixed the sacred oil for dedication and the pure spices for the sweet-smelling incense.
translation_text:
Apam Adaka no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 25.10-22)
1 Na Besalel de okuo yɛɛ adaka no, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa, na ne sorokɔ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 2Na ɔde sika amapa duraa emu ne ɛho, na ɔyɛɛ sika hankra twaa ho hyiae. 3Na ɔguu ɛho sika nkaa nnan de tuatuaa ne nan nnan no ho, nkaa mmienu wɔ ɔfa ha, na nkaa mmienu wɔ ɔfa ha. 4Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho. 5Na ɔde mpoma no wurawuraa nkaa no mu, adaka no nkyɛn mu, na wɔde asoa adaka no.
6Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ mpata adwa no, ne tentene bɛyɛ basafa baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 7Na ɔde sika a wɔaborɔ yɛɛ sika kerubim mmienu maa no firi mpata adwa no tiri mmienu no mu. 8Ɔyɛɛ kerub baako wɔ etire ha, na ɔyɛɛ kerub baako nso wɔ etire ha; mpata adwa no mu na ɔmaa kerubim no firii ne tiri mmienu no soɔ. 9Na kerubim no trɛtrɛɛ wɔn ntaban mu ɔsoro de wɔn ntaban no kataa mpata adwa no so, na wɔn ani kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn ho; na wɔn anim kyerɛkyerɛ mpata adwa no so.
Wɔyɛ ɛpono no
(Eksodɔs 25.23-30)
10 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ ɛpono no, ne tentene basafa baako, ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne sorokɔ bɛyɛ anammɔn mmienu ne fa. 11Na ɔde sika amapa duraa ho, na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika hankra hyiae. 12Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho mfemfamho a ne tɛtrɛtɛ te sɛ nsam hyiae, na ɔyɛɛ mfemfamho no ho sika hankra hyiae. 13Na ɔguu ɛho sika nkaa nnan, na ɔde nkaa no sisii ntwea nnan a ɛwɔ ne nan nnan ho no so. 14Mfemfamho no ase pa ara na nkaa a ɛyɛ mpoma a wɔde bɛsoa ɛpono no wurabea no wɔ. 15Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma no, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho, na wɔde asoa ɛpono no. 16Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ ɛpono no so nnoɔma, ne nyowa ne ne nyowaa ne ne nkuruwa ne ne nkoraa a wɔde bɛhwie.
Kaneadua no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 25.31-40)
17 Na ɔde sika amapa a wɔaboro na wɔde yɛɛ kaneadua no, ne nan ne ne dua; ɛho kuruwa, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren firi ɛno ara mu. 18Na nsa nsia tuatua ho, kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa tuatua ɔfa ha, na kaneadua no nsa mmiɛnsa tuatua ɔfa ha. 19Nkuruwa mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren, na nkuruwa mmiɛnsa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ wɔ nsa baako ho, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren: Saa ara na ɛteɛ wɔ nsa nsia a ɛtuatua kaneadua no ho no ho. 20Na kaneadua no ho nkuruwa a ɛte sɛ sorɔno deɛ no yɛ nnan, ne kukuduuduu ne ne nhwiren; 21na kukuduuduu no wowɔ nsa mmienu mmienu a ɛtuatua ho no ase, nsa nsia a ɛtuatua ho no ase. 22Ne kukuduuduu ne ne nsa no tua ho ara, ne nyinaa yɛ sika amapa a wɔaborɔ bafua. 23Na ɔde sika amapa yɛɛ ɛso nkanea nson no ne ɛho adaban ne ɛho nso nkukuwa. 24Sika amapa dwetikɛseɛ baako na ɔde yɛeɛ ɛne ɛho nnoɔma no nyinaa.
Wɔyɛ aduhwamhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no
(Eksodɔs 30.1-5)
25 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ aduhwamhyeɛ no afɔrebukyia, ne tentene yɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ nso bɛyɛ anammɔn baako ne fa, ɛyɛ ahinanan, ne sorokɔ yɛ basafa baako; ne mmɛn nso tuatua ho ara. 26Na ɔde sika amapa duraa ho, ɛso ne ɛho hyiae, ne ne mmɛn no; na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika hankra hyiae. 27Na ɔyɛɛ ɛho sika nkaa mmienu, wɔ ne hankra no ase, ne nkyɛn mu mmienu no so, sɛ ɛnyɛ mpoma no wurabea na wɔde asoa. 28Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde sika duraduraa ho.
Sra ngo ne Aduhwam no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 30.22-38)
29 Na ɔyɛɛ sra ngo kronkron ne ɛhyeɛ aduhwam korɔgyenn no, sɛdeɛ odufrafoɔ fra no.

english_text:
The Altar for Offering Sacrifices
(Exodus 27.1-8)
1Bezalel built an altar of acacia wood for offering sacrifices. It was 2.25 meters square and 1.34 meters high 2with each of its four corners sticking up like the horn of a bull, and it was completely covered with bronze. 3The equipment for the altar was also made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans. 4About halfway up the altar he built a ledge around it and covered the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating. 5Then he attached a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners to put the poles through. 6He covered two acacia wood poles with bronze and 7put them through the rings for carrying the altar, which was shaped like an open box.
The Large Bronze Bowl
(Exodus 30.18-21)
8 Bezalel made a large bowl and a stand out of bronze from the mirrors of the women who helped at the entrance to the sacred tent.
The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent
(Exodus 27.9-19)
9-17Around the sacred tent Bezalel built a courtyard 44 meters long on the south and north and 22 meters wide on the east and west. He used 20 bronze posts on bronze stands for the south and north and 10 for the west. Then he hung a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. He placed three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hung a curtain 6.67 meters wide on each set of posts.
18-19For the entrance to the courtyard, Bezalel made a curtain nine meters long, which he hung on four bronze posts that were set on bronze stands. This curtain was 2.25 meters high, the same height as the one for the rest of the courtyard, and was made of fine linen embroidered and woven with blue, purple, and red wool. He hung the curtain on the four posts, using silver hooks and rods. 20The pegs for the tent and for the curtain around the tent were made of bronze.
The Sacred Tent
21-23Bezalel had worked closely with Oholiab, who was an expert at designing and engraving, and at embroidering blue, purple, and red wool. The two of them completed the work that the Lord had commanded to be done.
Moses put Aaron's son Ithamar in charge of the Levites who kept record of the metals used for the sacred tent. 24According to the official weights, the amount of gold given was a ton, 25 and the silver that was collected when the people were counted came to 3.4 tons. 26 Everyone who was counted paid the required amount, and there was a total of 603,550 men who were 20 years old or older.
27Thirty-four kilograms of the silver were used to make each of the 100 stands for the sacred tent and the curtain. 28The remaining 30 kilograms of silver were used for the hooks and rods and for covering the tops of the posts.
29Two thousand four hundred and twenty-five kilograms of bronze were given. 30And it was used to make the stands for the entrance to the tent, the altar and its grating, the equipment for the altar, 31the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.
translation_text:
Wɔyɛ Ɔhyeɛ Afɔrebukyia no
(Eksodɔs 27.1-8)
1 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no, ne tentene yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, ɛyɛ ahinanan, na ne sorokorɔ yɛ basafa baako ne fa. 2Na ɔyɛɛ ne mmɛn, ne mfatorɔ nnan no so, emu ara na na ne mmɛn no tuatua, na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ duraa ho. 3Na ɔyɛɛ afɔrebukyia no ho nnoɔma nyinaa: Nsenaa ne sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa, adinam ne nsramma kukuwa no; ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa, ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ na ɛyɛeɛ. 4Na ɔnwonoo afɔrebukyia no ho kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan a wɔanwono no sɛ atena, ne bamma no ase firi fam kɔduru mfimfini. 5Na ɔguu nkaa nnan tuatuaa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan no ntwea nnan no so, sɛ ɛnyɛ mpoma no hyehyɛbea. 6Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ duraduraa ho. 7Na ɔde mpoma no wurawuraa nkaa no mu afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn nkyɛn na wɔde asoa. Ɔde ntaaboɔ na ɛyɛeɛ, na emu da kwan.
Wɔyɛ kuduo ne adihɔ
(Eksodɔs 30.18)
8 Na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ yɛɛ kuduo no, na ne ntaaseɛ nso yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a ɔnya firii mmaa a wɔba bɛsom, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, no kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nhwehwɛ mu.
9 Na ɔyɛɛ adihɔ no: Anafoɔ fam a ɛkyerɛ adihɔ ntwamutam a wɔde asaawa fitaa a wɔafira anwono, basafa aduonum, 10ne n’adum aduonu ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ aduonu, adum no mprɛngo ne ne mmeaeɛ yɛ dwetɛ; 11ne atifi fam ntwamutam no, basafa aduonum, n’adum aduonu ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ aduonu, adum no nnadewa ne ne mmeaeɛ yɛ dwetɛ; 12ne atɔeɛ fam ntwamutam no basafa aduonu nnum, n’adum du ne ne nnyinasoɔ du, adum no nkɔtɔkorɔ ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ; 13ne anim fam a ɛkyerɛ apueeɛ deɛ, basafa aduonu nnum, 14ɔfa ha ntwamutam basafa nson ne fa, n’adum mmiɛnsa ne ne nnyinasoɔ mmiɛnsa; 15na ɔfa baako no deɛ nso adihɔ no aboboano ɔfa ha ne ha ntwamutam basafa nson ne fa, n’adum mmiɛnsa ne ne nnyinasoɔ mmiɛnsa. 16Adihɔ no ntwamutam a ɛtwa ho hyia nyinaa, asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na wɔde yɛeɛ, 17na adum no yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, adum no mprɛngo ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ, ne tiri nnuraho yɛ dwetɛ; adihɔ no adum nyinaa, dwetɛ mmeaeɛ na ɛbeabea ho; 18na adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no yɛ adenwono adwuma a wɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na ayɛ, na ne tentene yɛ basafa du, na ne sorokorɔ wɔ ne trɛ mu yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, te sɛ adihɔ no ho ntwamutam no; 19na n’adum nnan, ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ nnan, ne nnadewa yɛ dwetɛ, na ne tiri nnuraho ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ. 20Na tenabea no ne adihɔ no ho mpɛɛwa a ɛtwa ho hyia no nyinaa yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ.
Ɔman no ayɛyɛdeɛ no anobuo
21 Yei ne tenabea no, adanseɛ tenabea no ho nnoɔma anobuo, sɛdeɛ wɔnam Mose anomu asɛm so maa Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Itamar buu ano maa Lewifoɔ som no. 22 Na Hur ba Uri ba Besalel a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu no yɛɛ deɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa; 23na deɛ ɔka ne ho ne Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu a ɔyɛ sika ne dua dwumfoɔ ne ɔnwomfoɔ a ɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa mu adwini no.
24 Sika a wɔde yɛɛ adwuma no nyinaa, kronkronbea no ho nnwuma nyinaa, ɛtoɔ sika no, ano si dwetikɛseɛ aduonu nkron ne nnwetɛbena ahanson aduasa, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ. 25Na asafo no mu nnipa a wɔkan wɔn no dwetɛ ano si dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne nnwetɛbena apem ahanson aduɔson nnum, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ. 26Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn fraa dodoɔ no mu a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduonu anaa deɛ ɛboro saa a wɔyɛ mpem ahansia ne mpensa ne ahanum aduonum no mu biara yii beka baako (a ɛyɛ dwetɛbena fa sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ). 27Na wɔde dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha no guu kronkronbea no nnyinasoɔ ne ntwamutam no nnyinasoɔ no, nnyinasoɔ ɔha no yɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha, dwetikɛseɛ baako yɛ nnyinasoɔ baako. 28Na nnwetɛbena apem ahanson aduɔson nnum no, ɔde yɛɛ adum no mprɛngo, na ɔde bi duraduraa etire tire, na ɔde bi beabeaa ho. 29Na ɛtoɔ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ no ano si dwetikɛseɛ aduɔson ne nnwetɛbena mpem mmienu ahanan. 30Na ɛno na ɔde yɛɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano nnyinasoɔ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afɔrebukyia ne ɛho kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan ne afɔrebukyia no ho nnoɔma nyinaa, 31ne adihɔ no nnyinasoɔ a ɛtwa ho hyia, ne adihɔ no aboboano nnyinasoɔ, ne tenabea no ho mpɛɛwa nyinaa, ne adihɔ no mpɛɛwa a ɛtwa ho hyia nyinaa.

english_text:
Making the Priestly Clothes
(Exodus 28.1-14)
1Beautiful priestly clothes were made of blue, purple, and red wool for Aaron to wear when he performed his duties in the holy place. This was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
2-3The entire priestly vest was made of fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool. Thin sheets of gold were hammered out and cut into threads that were skillfully woven into the vest. 4-5It had two shoulder straps to support it and a sash that fastened around the waist. 6Onyx stones were placed in gold settings, and each one was engraved with the name of one of Israel's sons. 7Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The Breastpiece
(Exodus 28.15-30)
8The breastpiece was made with the same materials and designs as the priestly vest. 9It was 22 centimeters square and folded double 10with four rows of three precious stones: A carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald were in the first row; 11a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond were in the second row; 12a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst were in the third row; 13and a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper were in the fourth row. They were mounted in a delicate gold setting, 14and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
15-18Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps. 19Two other gold rings were attached to the lower inside corners next to the vest, 20and two more near the bottom of the shoulder straps right above the sash. 21To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The Clothes for the Priests
(Exodus 28.31-43)
22The priestly robe was made of blue wool 23with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out. 24-26Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
27-29Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.
30The words “Dedicated to the Lord” were engraved on a narrow strip of pure gold, 31which was fastened to Aaron's turban. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
The Work Is Completed
(Exodus 35.10-19)
32So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make. 33Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands; 34the covering of tanned ram skins and fine leather; the inside curtain; 35the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy; 36the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread; 37the lampstand of pure gold, together with its equipment and oil; 38the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent; 39the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand; 40the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent; 41and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons.
42-43When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_text:
Asɔfoɔ Ntadeɛ no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 28.1-14)
1 Na bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan no, wɔde yɛɛ ɔsom ntadeɛ a wɔde bɛsom kronkronbea hɔ, na wɔyɛɛ Aaron ntade kronkron no, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
2Na ɔde sika ne bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira nwonoo asɔfotadeɛ no. 3Na wɔboroo sika tratra twitwaa no nteanteaa sɛ wɔde rebɛsa bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa no mu adi no adwini. 4Wɔyɛɛ ɛho mmatire a wɔde toa. Na wɔkaa ano mmienu no toae; 5na asɔfotadeɛ no nkyekyeremu a ɛwɔ soɔ no, ɛfiri emu ara te sɛ n’adwini no ara, sika ne bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 6Na wɔyɛɛ apopobibire aboɔ a ɛsisi sika nnwinneɛ mu a wɔakurukyire soɔ nsɔanodeɛ nkurukyireeɛ, sɛdeɛ Israel mma din teɛ. 7Na ɔde fam asɔfotadeɛ no mmatiri so sɛ ɛnyɛ Israelfoɔ no nkaeɛ aboɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
Adaaboɔ no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 28.15-30)
8Na ɔde adwinni nwonoo adaaboɔ no sɛdeɛ asɔfotadeɛ no adwini no teɛ, sika, bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira. 9Ɛyɛ ahinanan, wɔbuka adaaboɔ no to so, ne tentene yɛ saama na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ saama, na wɔbuka to so. 10Na wɔde aboɔ kyerɛpɛn nnan sisii mu. Kyerɛpɛn a ɛdi kan no yɛ bogyanamboɔ, akrateboɔ ne ahahammonoboɔ; 11na kyerɛpɛn a ɛtɔ so mmienu yɛ nsramaboɔ, hoaboɔ ne bɔwerɛboɔ; 12na kyerɛpɛn a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa yɛ akutuhonoboɔ, mfrafraeɛboɔ ne beredumboɔ; 13na kyerɛpɛn a ɛtɔ so nnan yɛ sikabereɛboɔ, apopobibireboɔ ne ahwehwɛboɔ; ne nsisimu no wɔyɛɛ ho sika nnwinneɛ hyiae. 14Na aboɔ no duru Israel mma no din ano, dummienu, sɛdeɛ wɔn din teɛ; ɛyɛ nsɔanodeɛ kurukyireeɛ, sɛdeɛ din no teɛ mmaako mmaako, sɛdeɛ mmusuakuo dummienu no teɛ. 15Na wɔde sika amapa yɛɛ adaaboɔ no so ntweaban a wɔawɔ no mmɛsa sɛ nhoma no. 16Na wɔyɛɛ sika nnwinneɛ mmienu ne sika nkaa mmienu, na wɔde nkaa mmienu no hyehyɛɛ adaaboɔ no ntwea mmienu so. 17Na wɔde sika mmɛsa mmienu no koakoaa nkaa mmienu a ɛwowɔ adaaboɔ no ntwea soɔ no mu. 18Na wɔde mmɛsa mmienu no ano mmienu a aka no koakoaa nnwinneɛ mmienu no mu, na wɔde hyehyɛɛ asɔfotadeɛ no mmatiri no so, anim fam. 19Na wɔyɛɛ sika nkaa mmienu de hyehyɛɛ adaaboɔ no ntwea mmienu no so, wɔ ano a ɛwɔ emu fam kyerɛ asɔfotadeɛ no. 20Na wɔyɛɛ sika nkaa mmienu bio de hyehyɛɛ asɔfotadeɛ no afaafa mmienu no so anim fam wɔ aseɛ a ɛbɛn ne ntoaeɛ, asɔfotadeɛ no nkyekyeremu no so. 21Na wɔde bibire nhoma kyekyeree adaaboɔ nkaa no de sosɔɔ asɔfotadeɛ no nkaa no mu sɛ ɛmfam asɔfotadeɛ no nkyekyeremu no atifi, na adaaboɔ no antwetwe amfiri asɔfotadeɛ no so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
Asɔfotadeɛ afoforɔ no yɛ
(Eksodɔs 28.31-43)
22 Na ɔyɛɛ asɔfotadeɛ no ase batakari no, wɔde birisi na ɛnwonoo ne nyinaa. 23Na batakari no tokuro da ne mfimfini te sɛ adaaboɔ mu tokuro, wɔde ntomaban abare tokuro no ano ahyia, na ansuane. 24Na wɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan a wɔafira yɛɛ atoaa aba nsɛsoɔ wɔ batakari no mmuano so. 25Na wɔyɛɛ sika amapa nnɔnnɔmma, na wɔde nnɔnnɔmma no sensɛnee atoaa aba no ntam ntam, batakari no mmuano no so de twaa ho hyiae, atoaa aba no ntam ntam; 26adɔmma ne atoaa aba, adɔmma ne atoaa aba didi so ara batakari no mmuano so hyia, na wɔde asom, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
27 Na wɔde nwera fɛfɛ a wɔanwono yɛɛ ntadeɛ yuu no maa Aaron ne ne mma, 28na nwera abotitene ne nwera ahokeka abotire ne nwera twakoto a wɔde asaawa fitaa a wɔafira ayɛ, 29ne adenwono aboomu a wɔde asaawa fitaa a wɔafira ne bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan yɛeɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
30 Na wɔboroo sika amapa tratraa de yɛɛ abɔanimu kronkron no, na wɔtwerɛɛ so atwerɛ sɛ nsɔanodeɛ so nkurukyireeɛ sɛ: Kronkron ma AWURADE. 31Na wɔde bibire homa kyekyeree fam abotitene no so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
Adwuma no wie
(Eksodɔs 35.10-19)
32Na wɔyɛɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ho adwuma nyinaa wiee, na Israelfoɔ yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa. 33Na wɔde tenabea no brɛɛ Mose: Ntomadan no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa, ne nkɔtɔkorɔ, ne nsisiho ntaaboɔ, ne mmeamu ne ne nsisimu adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ; 34ne adwennini nwoma a wɔahyɛ no kɔkɔɔ nkatasoɔ ne sukraman nwoma nkatasoɔ ne ntwamutam no; 35adanseɛ adaka ne ne mpoma ne mpata adwa no; 36ɛpono no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ne kyerɛ paanoo no; 37kaneadua kronkron no, ne ne nkanea a wɔasiesie sisi soɔ ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ne kanea no ngo; 38ne sika afɔrebukyia ne sra ngo ne ɔhyeɛ aduhwam ne ntomadan no ano nkataano no; 39kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan no, ne mpoma ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa; nkuduo no ne ne ntaaseɛ; 40adihɔ no ntwamutam, n’adum ne ne nnyinasoɔ ne adihɔ no aboboano nkataano, ne ntampehoma ne ne mpɛɛwa, ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no tenabea no som ho nnoɔma nyinaa; 41ɔsom ntadeɛ a wɔde som kronkronbea hɔ ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ntade kronkron ne ne mma ntadeɛ a wɔde bɛdi asɔfoɔ no. 42Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa ara na Israelfoɔ yɛɛ adwuma no nyinaa. 43Na Mose hwɛɛ adwuma no nyinaa, na hwɛ, wɔayɛ no sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛeɛ no, saa ara pɛ na wɔyɛeɛ. Na Mose hyiraa wɔn.

english_text:
The Lord's Tent Is Set Up
1The Lord said to Moses:
2Set up my tent on the first day of the year 3and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain. 4Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it. 5Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent. 6Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent. 7Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water. 8Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
9Use the sacred olive oil to dedicate to me the tent and everything in it. 10Do the same thing with the altar for offering sacrifices and its equipment 11and with the bowl and its stand. 12Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves. 13Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest. 14Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons 15and ordain them in the same way, so they and their descendants will always be my priests.
16Moses followed the Lord's instructions. 17And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up. 18The posts, stands, and framework were put in place, 19then the two layers of coverings were hung over them. 20The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached. 21The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
22The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place, 23after which the bread was set on the table. 24The lampstand was put along the south wall, 25then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord. 26The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain, 27and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
28The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent. 29Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there. 30The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water, 31then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet. 32In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
33Finally, Moses had the curtains hung around the courtyard and at the entrance.
The Glory of the Lord
34 Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord. 35And so, Moses could not enter the tent. 36Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow; 37then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again. 38No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_text:
Wɔtu Tenabea no hyɛ AWURADE nsa
1 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛdi kan no na si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no tenabea no. 3Na fa adanseɛ adaka no si mu, na fa ntwamutam no kata adaka no ani. 4Na fa ɛpono no kɔ mu, na siesie deɛ wɔde sisi soɔ no; na fa kaneadua no kɔ mu, na fa ne nkanea no sisi so. 5Na fa sika aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia no kɔsi adanseɛ adaka no anim; na fa tenabea no ano nkataano no sɛne hɔ. 6Na fa ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan tenabea no ano. 7Na fa kuduo no si ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam, na fa nsuo gu mu. 8Na sisi adihɔ no hyia, na fa adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no sɛne hɔ. 9Na fa sra ngo no sra tenabea no ne emu adeɛ nyinaa, na yɛ ɛno ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa kronkron na ɛnyɛ akronkronneɛ. 10Na sra ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ne ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa ngo, na yɛ afɔrebukyia no kronkron, na afɔrebukyia no nyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron. 11Na sra kuduo no ne ne ntaaseɛ no ngo, na yɛ no kronkron. 12Na fa Aaron ne ne mma no bra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na fa nsuo dware wɔn.
13Na fa ntade kronkron no hyɛ Aaron, na sra no ngo yɛ no kronkron, na ɔnni me sɔfoɔ. 14Na fa ne mma nso bra, na hyehyɛ wɔn ntadeɛ, 15na sra wɔn ngo, sɛdeɛ wosraa wɔn agya no, na wɔnni me asɔfoɔ, na wɔn sra no nyɛ wɔn daa asɔfodie, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. 16Na sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa, saa ara na ɔyɛeɛ.
17Na ɛbaa sɛ afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu no bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛdi kan no, wɔsii tenabea no. 18Na Mose sii tenabea no, na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne nnyinasoɔ na ɔgyinagyinaa ne ntaaboɔ no, na ɔde ne mmeamu no beabeaa mu, na ɔgyinagyinaa ne nsisimu adum. 19Na ɔyeree ntomadan no kataa tenabea no so, na ɔde ntomadan no nkatasoɔ no kataa so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 20Na ɔfaa Adanseɛ no de hyɛɛ adaka no mu, na ɔde mpoma wurawuraa adaka no ho, na ɔde mpata adwa no sii adaka no so; 21na ɔde adaka no kɔɔ tenabea no mu, na ɔsii ntwamutam no, na ɔde kataa adanseɛ adaka no ano, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 22Na ɔde ɛpono no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ atifi fam wɔ ntwamutam no akyi; 23na ɔsiesiee ɛso paanoo AWURADE anim sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 24Na ɔde kaneadua no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ɛpono no ntentensoɔ wɔ tenabea no nkyɛn mu a ɛkyerɛ anafoɔ fam; 25na ɔde nkanea no sisii so AWURADE anim, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 26Na ɔde sika afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ntwamutam no anim; 27na ɔhyee so aduhwam, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no. 28Na ɔde nkataano no sɛnee tenabea no ano. 29Na ɔde ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan tenabea no ano, na ɔbɔɔ so ɔhyeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 30Na ɔde kuduo no sii ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne afɔrebukyia no ntam, na ɔde nsuo guu mu sɛ wɔmfa nhohoro wɔn ho. 31Na Mose ne Aaron ne ne mma no de hohoroo wɔn nsa ne wɔn nan ho; 32sɛ wɔkɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu anaasɛ wɔrebɛbɛn afɔrebukyia no ho a, wɔhohoroo wɔn ho, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no. 33Na ɔsii adihɔ no de twaa tenabea no ne afɔrebukyia no ho hyiae, na ɔde adihɔ no aboboano ntwamutam no sɛnee hɔ. Na Mose wiee adwuma no.
Mununkum bɛkata Tenabea no so
(Numeri 9.15-23)
34 Ɛnna mununkum no bɛkataa ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no soɔ, na AWURADE animuonyam bɛhyɛɛ tenabea no ma. 35Na Mose antumi anhyɛne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, ɛfiri sɛ na mununkum no te so, na AWURADE animuonyam ahyɛ tenabea no ma. 36 Na Israelfoɔ akwantuo no nyinaa mu, sɛ mununkum no ma ne ho so firi tenabea no so a, na wɔkɔ wɔn anim; 37na sɛ mununkum no amma ne ho so a, ɛnneɛ wɔntu ara kɔsi da a ɛma ne ho soɔ. 38Ɛfiri sɛ wɔn akwantuo no nyinaa mu, na AWURADE mununkum no wɔ tenabea no so awia, na ogya wɔ mu anadwo, Israel fie no nyinaa anim.

english_text:
1-3The Lord spoke to Moses from the sacred tent and gave him instructions for the community of Israel to follow when they offered sacrifices.
Sacrifices To Please the Lord
The Lord said:
Sacrifices to please me must be completely burned on the bronze altar.
Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices. If the animal is a bull, it must not have anything wrong with it. Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, and I will let you know if it is acceptable to me. 4Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
5After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
6Skin the bull and cut it up, 7while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing. 8-9Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
10If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it. 11Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
12-13Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
14If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon. 15A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar, 16remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar. 17Finally, he will take the bird by its wings, tear it partially open, and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_text:
Ɔhyeɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ
1Na AWURADE frɛɛ Mose, na ɔfiri ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu kasa kyerɛɛ no sɛ: 2Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ, na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ mo mu nipa bi de ayɛyɛdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE a, afieboa a ɔfiri anantwie ne nnwan mu na momfa nyɛ mo ayɛyɛdeɛ mmra. 3 Sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛfiri anantwie mu a, ɔmfa onini a ɔdi mu mmra; ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano na ɔmfa no mmra, na wasɔ AWURADE ani. 4 Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no atifi, na ɛnsɔ ani mma no na ɛmpata mma no. 5Na ɔnkum nantwinini no, AWURADE anim, na Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no, mfa mogya no mmra, na wɔmfa mpete afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no so nhyia. 6Na ɔnnwa ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no nwoma, na ɔntwitwa no asinasini. 7Na Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron mma no nsiesie nnyina wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na wɔnsɔ ano. 8Na Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no, mfa asinasini no, botire no ne sradeɛ no ngu nnyina a ɛwɔ afɔrebukyia no gya no so. 9 Na ɔnhohoro n’ayamdeɛ ne ne nnyawa ho wɔ nsuo mu; na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye ne nyinaa afɔrebukyia no so, na ɛnyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.
10Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no firi nnwan mu, nnwanten anaa mmirekyie mu, na ɔde rekɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a, onini a ɔdi mu na ɔmfa mmra. 11 Na ɔnku no afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn mu atifi fam, AWURADE anim, na Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no, mfa ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia. 12 Na ɔntwitwa mu, n’asinasini no mu, ɛne ne ti ne ne sradeɛ nyinaa na ɔsɔfoɔ no nsiesie ngu afɔrebukyia no so. 13 Na ayamdeɛ ne nnyawa no, ɔmfa nsuo nhohoro ho; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nyinaa mmra mmɛhye no afɔrebukyia no so; ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.
14 Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no firi ntakraboa mu na ɔde rebɛbɔ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE a, ɔmfa anyankuku anaa mmorɔnoma mma nyɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ mmra. 15Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mmra afɔrebukyia no ho, na ɔnte ne ti na ɔnhye no afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔnkyi ne mogya ngu afɔrebukyia no ho. 16Na ɔnyi ne mene ase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nto ntwene afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn apueeɛ fam, deɛ nso guo hɔ. 17Na ɔnsuane no mu, n’atabu so, nanso ɔnnte mu, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ɛyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.

english_text:
Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord
The Lord said:
1When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour, 2and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 3The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
4If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
5If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast. 6Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil. 7If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
8You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar. 9Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 10The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
11Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice. 12You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
13Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
14Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest. 15You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice. 16A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_text:
Aduane afɔdeɛ
1Na sɛ obi de aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE a, n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no nyɛ esiam, na ɔngu so ngo, na ɔmfa ohwamfufuo nto so. 2Na ɔmfa mmrɛ Aaron mma no, asɔfoɔ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa esiam ne ngo no nsa mama, ne ohwamfufuo no nyinaa, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ. Ɛyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE. 3Na aduane afɔdeɛ no mu deɛ ɛbɛka no nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea, AWURADE gya mu akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ne no.
4Na sɛ wode aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ a wɔato no fononoo mu bi reba a, fa esiam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔre taterɛ ne apiti ɔfam a wɔagu so ngo bra. 5Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔakye no dadeɛ so a, ma no nyɛ esiam apiti a wɔde ngo afɔre; 6bubu mu asinasini, na hwie ngo gu so, aduane afɔdeɛ ne no.
7Na sɛ w’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ kukuo mu aduane afɔdeɛ a, fa esiam ne ngo yɛ. 8Na fa aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔde nnoɔma yi ayɛ no brɛ AWURADE; na wɔde brɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no a, ɔmfa mmra afɔrebukyia no ho. 9Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nyi ayɛyɛdeɛ no so nkaeɛ adeɛ no, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE ne no. 10Na aduane afɔdeɛ no nkaeɛ nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea; akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron a ɛfiri AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ mu ne no.
11 Aduane afɔdeɛ a mode bɛbrɛ AWURADE no nyinaa, mommfa mmɔreka nnyɛ; na monnhye mmɔreka biara ne ɛwoɔ biara sɛ ogya afɔdeɛ mmma AWURADE. 12 Momfa nnoɔma yi mmrɛ AWURADE sɛ aba a ɛdi kan mu afɔrebɔdeɛ, nanso wɔmmfa bi mmma afɔrebukyia no so sɛ ɛmmɛyi hwa hwanhwam. 13 Na w’aduane afɔdeɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ nyinaa, to mu nkyene, na mma wo Nyankopɔn apam nkyene mmpa w’aduane afɔdeɛ mu; fa nkyene ka w’ayɛyɛdeɛ nyinaa ho.
14Na sɛ wode aba a ɛdi kan ayɛyɛdeɛ rebrɛ AWURADE a, fa aburoo mmɛtem a wɔato no ogya mu atutu apɔn ho yɛ w’aba a ɛdi kan mu ayɛyɛdeɛ; 15na fa ngo gu so, na fa ohwamfufuo to so; aduane afɔdeɛ ne no. 16Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye aburoo mfuamfua a wɔapɔn ho no bi ne ngo no bi ne ohwamfufuo no nyinaa sɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ; ɛyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma AWURADE.

english_text:
Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing
The Lord said:
1When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal. 2Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
3Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides, 4as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. 5Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
6Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it. 7If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent. 8Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
9Offer the fat on the tail, the tailbone, and the insides, 10as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. 11One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
12If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me 13at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
14Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides, 15as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. 16One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me.
All fat belongs to me. 17So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_text:
Asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ
1Na sɛ obi ayɛyɛdeɛ yɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ, na anantwie no bi na ɔde reba a, onini oo, ɔbedeɛ oo, deɛ ɔdi mu na ɔmfa no mmra AWURADE anim. 2Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnku no, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na Aaron mma no, asɔfoɔ no, mfa mogya no mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia. 3Na ɔnyi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no bi mmra mmɛyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ; sradeɛ a ɛkata ayamdeɛ no soɔ no ne ayamdeɛ no ho sradeɛ nyinaa, 4ne sawa mmienu no ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no; ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi. 5Na Aaron mma no nhye no afɔrebukyia no so, mpae ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɛgu ogya no so, na ɛnyɛ ogya afɔdeɛ a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam ma AWURADE.
6Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɔde rebɛbɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE no yɛ nnwan no bi a, onini oo, ɔbedeɛ oo, deɛ ɔdi mu na ɔmfa mmra. 7Sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ yɛ adwammaa na ɔde reba a, ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim; 8na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnku no ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na Aaron mma no mfa ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia. 9Na ɔnyi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no bi mmra mmɛbɔ ogya afɔdeɛ mma AWURADE; ne sradeɛ ne ne sradeɛ duapuo a ɔntwa no padua so pa ara ne sradeɛ a ɛkata ayamdeɛ soɔ ne ayamdeɛ ho sradeɛ nyinaa, 10ne sawa mmienu no ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no; ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi. 11Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no afɔrebukyia no so: Ɛyɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ no gya so ma AWURADE.
12Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ abirekyie a, ɔmfa mmra AWURADE anim; 13na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’atifi, na ɔnku no, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, na Aaron mma no mfa ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia. 14Na ɔnyi bi mmra mmɛyɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ, AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ: Sradeɛ a ɛkata ayamdeɛ soɔ no ne ayamdeɛ ho sradeɛ nyinaa; 15ne sawa mmienu no, ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no; ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi. 16Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no wɔ afɔrebukyia no so; ɛyɛ ogya afɔreduane a ɛyi hwa hwanhwam; sradeɛ no nyinaa yɛ AWURADE dea. 17 Ɛnyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu ne mo tenabea nyinaa sɛ: Monnni sradeɛ anaa mogya biara.

english_text:
Sacrifices for Sin
(Leviticus 6.24-30)
1The Lord told Moses 2to say to the community of Israel:
Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do.
When the High Priest Sins
The Lord said:
3When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it. 4The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there. 5He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent, 6dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain. 7Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
8-10The priest will remove the fat from the bull, just as he does when he sacrifices a bull to ask my blessing. This includes the fat on the insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. He will then send it all up in smoke.
11-12The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap.
When the Whole Nation Sins
The Lord said:
13When the nation of Israel disobeys me without meaning to, the whole nation is still guilty. 14Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, 15where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
16The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent, 17dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain. 18Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent. 19-21After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven.
When a Tribal Leader Sins
The Lord God said:
22Any tribal leader who disobeys me without knowing it is still guilty. 23As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it. 24This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar. 25The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar. 26Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven.
When Ordinary People Sin
The Lord said:
27 When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty. 28As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it. 29Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed. 30Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar. 31After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
32If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it. 33Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed. 34The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar. 35After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_text:
Bɔne ho afɔdeɛ
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Sɛ obi anhyɛda na ɔyɛ nnoɔma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu biara, 3sɛ nso ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔasra no ɔsɔfo panin yɛ bɔne ma ɔman no di so a, ɛnneɛ ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ nti ma no mfa nantwie ba onini a ɔdi mu mmrɛ AWURADE mmɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ. 4Na ɔmfa nantwinini no mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, AWURADE anim, na ɔmfa ne nsa nto n’atifi, na ɔnku no, AWURADE anim. 5Na ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔasra no no mfa nantwie no mogya no bi nkɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, 6 na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa mmɔ mogya no mu, na ɔmpete mogya no bi mprɛnson, AWURADE anim, kronkronbea ntwamutam no anim. 7 Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mogya no bi nkeka aduhwamhyeɛ bukyia a ɛwɔ AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan mu no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie nantwie no mogya nyinaa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɛwɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano no ase. 8Na ɔnyi bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwie no sradeɛ nyinaa mfiri ne ho; sradeɛ a ɛkata ayamdeɛ so ne ayamdeɛ ho sradeɛ nyinaa, 9ne sawa mmienu no ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ so, sisia mu no ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan no; ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi, 10sɛdeɛ wɔyi firi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nantwie ho no; na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no so. 11 Na ɔmfa nantwinini no nwoma ne ne nam nyinaa ne ne ti ne ne nnyawa ne n’ayamdeɛ ne n’agyanan no, 12 nantwinini mu no nyinaa, mfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, deɛ ɛhɔ teɛ, deɛ wɔhwie nso guo, na ɔmfa ogya nhye no nnyina so; deɛ wɔhwie nso guo na wɔnhye no.
Ɔman mu no
13 Na sɛ Israel asafo nyinaa fom, na asɛm no ahunta ɔman no ani so, na wɔyɛ nnoɔma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu bi, na wɔdi so, 14 na wɔhunu bɔne a wɔayɛ de afom no a, ɛnneɛ, asafo no mfa nantwie ba onini mmra mmɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na wɔmfa no mmra ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano. 15Na asafo no mu mpanimfoɔ mfa wɔn nsa ngu nantwinini no atifi, na wɔnkum nantwie no, AWURADE anim. 16Na ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔasra no no mfa nantwinini no mogya no bi nhyɛne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu; 17na ɔmfa ne nsateaa mmɔ mogya no mu mfa mpete mprɛnson, AWURADE anim, ntwamutam no anim, 18na ɔmfa mogya no bi nkeka afɔrebukyia a ɛsi AWURADE anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie mogya no nyinaa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia a ɛsi ahyiaeɛ ntomadan ano no ase. 19Na ɔnyi ne sradeɛ nyinaa mfiri so, na ɔnhye no afɔrebukyia no so. 20Na sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ nantwinini no, saa ara na wɔnyɛ yei nso; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma wɔn, na wɔde bɛkyɛ wɔn. 21 Na ɔmfa nantwinini no mfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi, na ɔnhye no sɛdeɛ wɔhyee kane nantwinini no, asafo no bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne no.
Ɔmanfoɔ no mu atitire
22Sɛ otitire bi anhyɛ da na ɔyɛ nnoɔma a AWURADE ne Nyankopɔn ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no nyinaa mu adeɛ baako, na ɔdi so, na sɛ wɔma no hunu ne bɔne a wayɛ no a, 23ɛnneɛ, ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ ɔpapo a ɔdi mu mmra; 24na ɔmfa ne nsa nto ɔpapo no atifi, na ɔnku no deɛ wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wɔ AWURADE anim: Bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne no. 25Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa mfa bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie ne mogya no ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ase. 26Na ɔnhye ne sradeɛ nyinaa wɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no so sɛ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ sradeɛ no; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, ne bɔne no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.
Ɔmanfoɔ no
27Na sɛ asase no so nkurɔfoɔ no mu biara anhyɛda na ɔyɛ nnoɔma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu adeɛ baako, na ɔdi so, na sɛ wɔma no hunu ne bɔne a wayɛ a, 28ɛnneɛ, ne bɔne a wayɛ no nti, ɔmfa n’ayɛyɛdeɛ, abirekyibereɛ a ɔdi mu mmra mmɛma; 29na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnkum bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no deɛ wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ hɔ. 30Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa nka mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie ne mogya nyinaa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ase. 31 Na ɔnyi ɛho sradeɛ sɛdeɛ wɔyi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ deɛ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.
32Na sɛ ɔde adwammaa bɛyɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ ba bɛbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ a, ɔmfa ɔbedeɛ a ɔdi mu mmra. 33Na ɔmfa ne nsa nto bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no atifi, na ɔnku no nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, deɛ wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ hɔ. 34Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa ne nsateaa nka bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no mogya no bi nkeka ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no mmɛn ho, na ɔnhwie mogya no nyinaa ngu afɔrebukyia no ase. 35Na ɔnyi ne sradeɛ nyinaa, sɛdeɛ wɔyi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ adwammaa ho sradeɛ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye no afɔrebukyia so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE gya afɔrebɔ teɛ no; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, ne bɔne a wayɛ no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no.

english_text:
The Lord said:
1If you refuse to testify in court about something you saw or know has happened, you have sinned and can be punished.
2You are guilty and unfit to worship me, if you accidentally touch the dead body of any kind of unclean animal.
3You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
4You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.
5As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done. 6Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
7If you are poor and cannot afford to bring an animal, you may bring two doves or two pigeons. One of these will be a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, and the other will be a sacrifice to please me.
8Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head, 9splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar. 10Then he will follow the proper rules for offering the other bird as a sacrifice to please me.
You will be forgiven when the priest offers these sacrifices as the price for your sin.
11If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it. 12Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me. 13By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices.
Sacrifices To Make Things Right
(Leviticus 7.1-10)
14-15The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to:
If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests. 16In addition, you must pay what you owe plus a fine of 20 percent. Then the priest will offer the ram as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven.
17-19If you break any of my commands without meaning to, you are still guilty, and you can be punished. When you realize what you have done, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven.
translation_text:
Bɔne ahodoɔ ho afɔrebɔ
1 Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne sɛ wate ntanka nne na ɔne ɛho danseni, sɛ ɔhunui oo, ɔtee oo, na wanka a, ɔbɛsoa ne mmusuo. 2 Anaasɛ sɛ obi ka afideɛ biara, sɛ aboa bi a ne ho nteɛ funu, anaa afieboa bi a ne ho nteɛ funu, anaa aboaa bi a ne ho nteɛ funu, na ɔnnim mpo a, ne ho agu fi, na ɔdi so. 3Anaasɛ sɛ ɔka onipa ho fi bi, na sɛ afideɛ a ama oniiko ho agu fi no te sɛn ara, na ɔnnim mpo a, sɛ akyire yi ɔhunu a, ɔdi so.
4Sɛ asɛnhunu firi onipa anomu anaasɛ ɔka ntam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ bɔne anaa papa bi na ɔnnim mpo a, sɛ akyire n’ani ba ne ho so a, ɔdi adeɛ yi mu biara ho so; 5na afei sɛ ɔdi adeɛ yi mu biara ho so a, ɔnka deɛ wayɛ mu bɔne no, 6na ne bɔne a wayɛ no nti, ɔmfa n’asodie ho afɔdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, nnwan mu ɔbedeɛ, odwanten anaa abirekyie, na ɛnyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no wɔ ne bɔne no ho.
7Na sɛ ne nsa anso odwan so a, ɔmfa anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu mmrɛ AWURADE mmɛyɛ bɔne a wayɛ no mu asodie ho afɔdeɛ; baako nyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, na baako nyɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ. 8 Na ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no, na ɔmfa deɛ ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no kane, na ɔnkyinsa ne ti, ne kɔn so, nanso ɔnnte mfiri so; 9na ɔmfa bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no mogya no bi mpete afɔrebukyia no ho, na mogya no nkaeɛ no ɔmfa ngu ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no ase, bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne no. 10 Na deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu no, ɔmfa no mmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ, sɛdeɛ ne yɛbea teɛ. Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no wɔ ne bɔne a wayɛ no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no. 11 Na sɛ ne nsa anso anyankuku mmienu anaa mmorɔnoma mma mmienu so a, deɛ ɔmfa nyɛ ne bɔne a ɔyɛeɛ ho ayɛyɛdeɛ ne esiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako, na ɛnyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ; ɔmmfa ngo nngu so, na ɔmmfa ohwamfufuo nnto so, ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ. 12Na ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa mu nsa ma nyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ, na ɔnhye no afɔrebukyia no so, sɛdeɛ AWURADE gya afɔrebɔ teɛ no: Bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne no. 13 Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, ne bɔne a wayɛ nnoɔma yi biara mu no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no; na nkaeɛ no nyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no deɛ, sɛ aduane afɔdeɛ.
Asodie ho afɔdeɛ
14Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 15Sɛ obi anhyɛ da yɛ bɔne a ɛyɛ kusumdie wɔ AWURADE akronkronneɛ ho a, ɛnneɛ, n’asodie afɔdeɛ a ɔmfa mmrɛ AWURADE ne odwennini a ɔdi mu, sɛdeɛ wobɛbɔ ne boɔ, dwetɛ nnwetɛbena mu, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena teɛ; na ɛnyɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ. 16 Na deɛ wayɛ ɛho bɔne, akronkronneɛ mu no, ɔnsi ananmu, na ɔmfa mu abupɛn nnum mu baako mpae so, na ɔmfa mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no, na ɔsɔfoɔ no mfa asodie ho afɔdeɛ dwennini no mpata mma no, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no. 17Na sɛ obi yɛ bɔne yɛ nnoɔma a AWURADE ahyɛ sɛ wɔnnyɛ no mu adeɛ baako a, sɛ wanhunu mpo a, ɔdi so na ɔso ne mmusuo; 18na ɔmfa odwennini a ɔdi mu mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no, sɛdeɛ wobɛbɔ ne boɔ, na ɛnyɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ; na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no, fom a wafom na wanhunu no ho, na wɔde bɛkyɛ no. 19 Asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne no. AWURADE ho so na wadie.

english_text:
Other Sins That Need Sacrifices or Payments
(Numbers 5.5-10)
1-3 The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord:
You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
4When this happens, you must return what doesn't belong to you 5and pay the owner a fine of 20 percent. 6-7In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong.
Daily Sacrifices
(Exodus 29.38-43; Numbers 28.1-8)
8-9The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord:
You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning. 10The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar. 11Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
12The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
13The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out.
Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord
The Lord said:
14When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar, 15where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 16-17The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
18Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change.
When Priests Are Ordained
19The Lord spoke to Moses 20and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained:
It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour 21mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. 22-23Each of Aaron's descendants who is ordained as a priest must perform this ceremony and make sure that the bread is completely burned on the altar. None of it may be eaten!
Sacrifices for Sin
(Leviticus 4.1,2)
24The Lord told Moses 25how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin:
This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar. 26The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent, 27and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place. 28If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
29This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it. 30None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_text:
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne di AWURADE kusum sɛ ɔsane ne yɔnko adeɛ bi a ɔde ama no asie, anaasɛ ɔde ahyɛ ne nsa, anaasɛ ɔbɔ korɔno, anaasɛ ɔdi ne yɔnko amim, 3anaasɛ wahunu biribi a ayera na ɔsane, na ɔka ntanhunu, sɛ onipa yɛ yeinom biara mu bɔne, 4 sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔyɛ bɔne na ɔdi so saa a, ɔmfa adeɛ a ɔfaeɛ anaa adeɛ a ɔdii mu amim, anaa adeɛ a wɔde maa no asie anaa adeɛ a ɛyeraeɛ a ɔhunuiɛ, 5 anaa adeɛ biara a ɔkaa ɛho ntanhunu no nsane mmra, ɔmfa ne nyinaa mmra, na ɔmfa abupɛn nnum mu baako mpae so mma ɔdenadeɛ no, n’asodie ho afɔrebɔ da no ara; 6 na ɔmfa n’asodie ho afɔdeɛ a ɔde rebrɛ AWURADE no mmrɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no, nnwan mu odwennini a ɔdi mu, sɛdeɛ wobɛbɔ ne boɔ, na ɛnyɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ. 7Na ɔsɔfoɔ no mpata mma no wɔ AWURADE anim, na wɔde adeɛ biara a wayɛ a ɔdi ho so no bɛkyɛ no.
Ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ho mmara
8Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 9 Hyɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Yei ne ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ho mmara: Ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no ntena asomurofi, afɔrebukyia no so anadwo mu nyinaa nkɔsi anɔpa, na wɔmma afɔrebukyia no so gya no nnɛre wɔ so. 10 Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhyɛ ne nwera atadeɛ, na ɔnhyɛ ne nwera twakoto nkata ne ho, na ɔnsesa nso a ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ogya no hye gyaa no afɔrebukyia no soɔ no ngu afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn. 11 Na ɔnyi ne ntadeɛ no, na ɔnhyɛ ntadeɛ foforɔ, na ɔmfa nso no mfiri nkɔ nsraban no akyi nkɔgu deɛ ɛhɔ teɛ. 12Na wɔmma afɔrebukyia so gya no nnɛre, ennnum ara da, na ɔsɔfoɔ no nsɔ nnyina wɔ so daa anɔpa, na ɔnsiesie ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ no wɔ so, na ɔnhye so asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ho sradeɛ no. 13Ogya nnɛre afɔrebukyia no so daa, ɛnnnum da.
14 Na yei ne aduane afɔdeɛ ho mmara: Aaron mma no mfa mmra AWURADE anim wɔ afɔrebukyia no anim. 15Na ɔmfa aduane afɔdeɛ no esiam no nsa ma ne ngo no bi ne aduane afɔdeɛ no so hwamfufuo nyinaa, na ɔnhye wɔ afɔrebukyia no so, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam nyɛ nkaeɛ adeɛ mma AWURADE. 16Na nkaeɛ no, Aaron ne ne mma no nni no apiti, wɔnni no deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no adihɔ na wɔnnie. 17Wɔmmfa mmɔreka mmfra nnto. Wɔn kyɛfa a mede mama wɔn wɔ me gya afɔdeɛ mu ne no; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron, sɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne asodie ho afɔdeɛ. 18Aaron mma mu mmarima nyinaa nni; ɛnyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ ahodoɔ ho daa ahyɛdeɛ, mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu. Obiara a ɔka no nyɛ kronkron.
19Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 20 Yei ne Aaron ne ne mma ayɛyɛdeɛ a wɔmfa mmrɛ AWURADE, ɛda a wɔsra no ngo no; esiam olonka abupɛn du mu baako nyɛ daa ayɛyɛdeɛ, anɔpa deɛ fa na anwummerɛ deɛ fa. 21Wɔmfa ngo nkye no dadeɛ ayowa mu; yɛ no nkyekyeewa bra; yɛ no sɛ aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔatoto abubu mu asinasini bra, na ɛnyi hwa hwanhwam mma AWURADE. 22Na ɔsɔfoɔ a wɔbɛsra no ngo asi n’ananmu wɔ ne mma mu no na ɔnyɛ; ɛyɛ AWURADE daa ahyɛdeɛ; wɔnhye no mu. 23Na ɔsɔfoɔ no aduane afɔdeɛ nyinaa wɔnhye no mu; wɔnnni bi.
Bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ho mmara
24Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 25 Kasa kyerɛ Aaron ne ne mma no sɛ: Yei ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ho mmara: Faako a wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ aboa no, ɛhɔ ara na wɔnkum bɔne ho afɔdeɛ deɛ no, AWURADE anim; akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ne no. 26Ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ no na ɔnnie; faako a ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron na wɔnni wɔ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no adihɔ. 27Obiara a ɔka nam no nyɛ kronkron; na deɛ mogya no bi apete n’atadeɛ mu no nsi deɛ ɛpetee mu no wɔ deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron. 28Na ahina a wɔnoaa no wɔ mu no, wɔmmɔ, na sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ sɛn mu na wɔnoaeɛ a, wɔntwi mu na wɔmfa nsuo nhohoro mu. 29Mmarima a wɔfiri asɔfoɔ abusuakuo mu nyinaa nni bi; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron. 30Na bɔne ho afɔdeɛ a wɔde ne mogya no bi ba ahyiaeɛ ntomadan mu bɛpata wɔ kronkronbea hɔ no nyinaa, wɔnnni, wɔmfa ogya nhye.

english_text:
Sacrifices To Make Things Right
(Leviticus 5.14-19)
The Lord said:
1The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred. 2The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar. 3Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides, 4as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat. 5One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me. 6This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
7The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
8In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal, 9just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me. 10All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family.
Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing
The Lord said:
11Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing: 12If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil. 13You must also make some bread with yeast. 14Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
15When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day. 16It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day, 17-18but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
19Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me. 20-21But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
22The Lord told Moses 23to say to the people:
Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats. 24If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it. 25If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel. 26 And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal, 27or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
28The Lord also told Moses 29-30to say to the people of Israel:
If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me. 31A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests. 32-33The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal. 34I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants 35who have been ordained as priests to serve me. 36This law will never change. I am the Lord!
37These are the ceremonies for sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessing or his forgiveness, as well as the ceremonies for those sacrifices that demand a payment and for the sacrifices that are offered when priests are ordained. 38While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_text:
Asodie afɔdeɛ ho mmara
1 Na yei ne asodie ho afɔdeɛ ho mmara; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron. 2 Faako a wɔkum ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ aboa no, ɛhɔ ara na wɔnkum asodie ho afɔdeɛ deɛ no nso; na ɔnhwie ne mogya mpete afɔrebukyia no so nhyia. 3Na ɔnyi ne sradeɛ nyinaa mmra: Ne sradedua, ne sradeɛ a ɛkata ayamdeɛ ho no, 4 ne sawa mmienu ne sradeɛ a ɛwɔ ho, sisia mu no, ne mmerɛboɔ so ntentan, ɔmfiri sawa ho nyi; 5na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye ne nyinaa afɔrebukyia no so nyɛ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ; asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne no. 6Mmarima a wɔfiri asɔfoɔ abusuakuo nyinaa nni; deɛ ɛhɔ yɛ kronkron na wɔnnie; ɛyɛ akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron. 7Sɛ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ teɛ no, sɛ asodie ho afɔdeɛ nso teɛ ne no, mmara korɔ na ɛda ho; ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔde pata no, ɛnyɛ ne dea. 8 Na ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔbɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma obi no, ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ a ɔbɔeɛ no nwoma nyɛ ɔsɔfoɔ no dea. 9 Na aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔto no fononoo mu nyinaa ne deɛ wɔsiesie no kukuo mu ne ɛkyeɛ dadeɛ soɔ nyinaa, ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔde ba no na ɛnyɛ ne dea. 10Na aduane afɔdeɛ a wɔagu so ngo anaa deɛ ɛyɛ wesee nyɛ Aaron mma nyinaa deɛ, obiara nnya sɛdeɛ ne yɔnko nya.
Asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ
11 Na yei ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ a wɔbɔ ma AWURADE no ho mmara. 12 Sɛ wɔyɛ no aseda afɔdeɛ de ba a, aseda afɔdeɛ a ɔde ba no nyɛ apiti taterɛ a wɔde ngo afɔre, ne apiti ɔfam a wɔde ngo agu soɔ ne esiam taterɛ a wɔde ngo afɔre akyeɛ. 13Mmɔreka paanoo taterɛ na ɔmfa nka n’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne n’asomdwoeɛ aseda afɔdeɛ no ho mmra. 14Na ɔmfa ayɛyɛdeɛ no mu biara baako mmra, na wɔmma so mma AWURADE, ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔde asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya peteeɛ no na ɛnyɛ ne dea. 15 Na n’asomdwoeɛ aseda afɔdeɛ no nam no, wɔnni no da a wɔde baeɛ no ara, wɔnnnya bi nnkɔsi adekyeeɛ. 16Na sɛ n’ayɛyɛdeɛ no yɛ bɔhyɛ anaa ayamyi ayɛyɛdeɛ a, wɔnni no da a ɔbɔ n’afɔdeɛ no, na sɛ adeɛ kye bi so a, wɔnni ara; 17na afɔdeɛ no nam a ɛbɛka akɔsi da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no, wɔmfa ogya nhye. 18Na sɛ obi di n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nam no bi da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no a, ɛrensɔ ani, na wɔremmu mma deɛ ɔde baeɛ no, ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ, na ɔkra a ɔbɛdi bie no bɛsoa ne mmusuo. 19Na nam a aka biribi a ɛho nteɛ no, wɔnnni; wɔmfa ogya nhye. Na nam deɛ, obiara a ne ho teɛ nni, 20nanso ɔkra a ɔbɛdi asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nam a ɛyɛ AWURADE dea no bie, na n’afideɛ da ne soɔ no, wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene. 21Na ɔkra bi a ɔbɛka afideɛ biara, onipa ho afideɛ bi oo, aboa a ne ho nteɛ oo, akyiwadeɛ biara a ɛho nteɛ oo, na ɔbɛdi AWURADE asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ nam no bie no, wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene.
Mogya ne sradeɛ akyiwadeɛ
22Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 23 Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Nantwie ne odwanten ne abirekyie sradeɛ biara, monnni. 24 Na aboa funu sradeɛ ne deɛ wɔatete no sradeɛ, wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma biara, na die na monnnie. 25Na obiara a ɔbɛdi afieboa a wɔde bi bɛbɔ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ sradeɛ no, wɔbɛtwa ɔkra a ɔdie no afiri ne man mu atwene. 26 Na mogya biara nso, anomaa deɛ oo, atɔteboa deɛ oo, monnni wɔ mo tenabea biara mu. 27Ɔkra biara a ɔbɛdi mogya biara no, wɔbɛtwa saa ɔkra no afiri ne man mu atwene.
Asɔfoɔ no kyɛfa
28Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 29Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Deɛ ɔbɛbɔ n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ ama AWURADE no, ɔmfa n’asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no mu ayɛyɛdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE. 30 Ɔno ara ne nsa na ɔmfa nsɔ AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ no mu mmra, sradeɛ ne ɔyan na ɔmfa mmra; ɔyan no, wɔnhim nyɛ ohim afɔdeɛ AWURADE anim. 31Na ɔsɔfoɔ no nhye sradeɛ no, afɔrebukyia no so, na ɔyan no nyɛ Aaron ne ne mma dea. 32 Na ɔsrɛ nifa no, momfa nyɛ mo asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mu mmasoɔ adeɛ mma ɔsɔfoɔ no. 33Aaron mma mu deɛ ɔde asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mogya ne sradeɛ ba no, ɔno na ɔsrɛ nifa no nyɛ ne kyɛfa. 34Na ohim yan ne mmasoɔ srɛ no na mafa, Israelfoɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no mu, na mede mama Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ne ne mma sɛ wɔn daa kyɛfa a ɛfiri Israel mma nsam.
35Yei ne Aaron kyɛfa ne ne mma kyɛfa a ɛfiri AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ mu, ɛda a wɔde wɔn baa sɛ wɔmmɛdi AWURADE asɔfoɔ 36na AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa mma wɔn, ɛda a wɔsraa wɔn ngo firii Israelfoɔ mu, sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn daa kyɛfa, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa mu no. 37 Yei ne mmara a ɛda hɔ ma ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne aduane afɔdeɛ ne bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ne asodie ho afɔdeɛ ne atuhoakyɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ 38a AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose, Sinai bepɔ soɔ, ɛda a ɔhyɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ayɛyɛdeɛ mmrɛ AWURADE, Sinai serɛ soɔ no.

english_text:
The Ceremony for Ordaining Priests
(Exodus 29.1-37)
1The Lord said to Moses:
2Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast. 3Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
4Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together, 5he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
6After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves. 7He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt. 8Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do. 9He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
10Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination. 11He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base. 12He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord. 13Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
14Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head. 15After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin. 16Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire. 17Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
18Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head, 19Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar. 20-21Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
22Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head, 23and it was killed.
